I wanted to start a simple thread of flavor opinions / additions. It is important that every review begin with the reviewers flavor preference since these things can be very subjective and will give the reader slight insight as to relate-ability. This should be followed by 1-10 scale rating and your preferred mix % and just a sentence or two describing the flavor and any relevant notes. Standard abbr. for all the major suppliers. If you are writing about an obscure one please give full name / web info.

Example:

My Flavor Pref: Sweet fruity / creamy

Cucumber (CAP): +7 Best cucumber i've tried overall but doesn't blow my hair back. Best to start at a low 2-3% and work slowly from there as this flavor has the ability to quickly ruin a mix. This days we hear people complaining about Techies being annoying. And when they mention a counter they say stuff like Chen, Naga... Which it is but not as Lanaya.

I play Lanaya a lot and I surely do when a Techies against me and here's why...

He will mine runes, but you will have bottle and Refraction. You go to the rune to get it and you deny mines by that on the same time.

We know that we all fear getting close to Techies because they will put a mine don't then suicide and kill you. With Lanaya I farm Techies sense he think he is untouchable and get out of position most of the time. And with her high damage you can kill him fast without need to chase him so his teammates react.

When you win a fight and have to go high ground sometimes Techies kill you all your team with his mines but normally you don't and with a Deso and AC you can push rax alone easily.

So my advice to counter Techies is pick Lanaya, keep Refraction always on you (with a bottle you will never need mana on first minutes...) and even on Dotabuff according to stats Lanaya is the first counter to Techies.
